title: We're Marching to Zion
lyrics_original: Come, ye that love the Lord,
And let your joys be known;
Join in a song with sweet accord,
Join in a song with sweet accord,
But children of the heav’nly King,
But children of the heav’nly King
Before we reach the heav’nly fields,
Before we reach the heav’nly fields,

bible_verses.english: I was glad when they said to me, “Let’s go to Yahweh’s house!”
I saw, and behold, the Lamb standing on Mount Zion, and with him a number, one hundred forty-four thousand, having his name and his Father’s name written on their foreheads.
But you have come to Mount Zion, and to the city of the living God, the heavenly Jerusalem, and to innumerable multitudes of angels,

devotional.prayer_english: Lord God, thank You for inviting me into Your joyful kingdom and giving me brothers and sisters to walk beside. Fill my heart with the gladness of Your presence today as I fix my eyes on the hope of heaven. Keep my feet steady on this journey, and let my life reflect the beauty of Your coming glory. May our worship today be a sweet echo of the song we will sing around Your throne forever. Amen.

devotional.reflection_english: When we gather to sing, we are not just voicing melody; we are joining our hearts with a vast family of faith traveling together toward God's presence. Every step of our earthly journey is brightened by the joy of knowing where we are headed—the heavenly city of God. As we lift our voices in sweet accord, let your heart be refreshed by the hope of glory. Together, we walk upward with gladness, looking forward to the day we surround His throne forever.
